SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Special Branch - S.2.
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNI... C & S. B. REGISTER... No. D 3682... Date June 13, 1932. Date 14/6/32）

Subject (in full) Municipal Advocate's opinion on Bookstores selling
pro-communist books.

Made by D.P.S.Pit... Forwarded by （签名）

（手写批注：CCC）

In compliance with the instructions of the Officer
i/c Special Branch, the three attached books - "Marx's
Wages, Price and Profits", "Economic Organisation of
Soviet Russia" and "Le Monde et La Chine" - were placed
before the Municipal Advocate for his opinion regarding
the institution of legal proceedings against the bookstores
selling these volumes.

I was informed by the Municipal Advocate that these
books, with the exception of "Economic Organisation of
Soviet Russia" are not included in the list of publications
proscribed by the Central Kuomintang Party and he there-
fore was unable to recommend that the booksellers be pro-
secuted under the "Communist Law."

It was possible, however, to make a charge under the
"Publication Law", but in this particular instance he did
not think it advisable to press charges, as he felt sure
convictions would be difficult to secure.

"Economic Organisation of Soviet Russia" is included
in the list of books proscribed by the Central Kuomintang
Party, but according to the Municipal Advocate, should the
vendor be charged and be found guilty, a small fine only
would be inflicted. Therefore he did not consider it ad-
visable to press a charge.

I submit herewith a list issued by the Shanghai Spec-
ial District Kuomintang Headquarters, showing books and
periodicals that are prohibited or proscribed in China.
Vendors or printers of such publications can be proceeded
against under the "Publication Law."

（签名）
D. P. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

报告

（印章：上海公共租... C & S. B. 登记簿... 编号 D 3682... 日期 1932年6月13日。日期 1932年6月14日）

主题（全称） 市法律顾问关于书店出售亲共书籍的意见。

由 D.P.S.Pit... 呈报 （签名）

（手写批注：CCC）

遵照特务科主管官员的指示，现将所附三本书籍——《马克思的工资、价格和利润》、《苏俄的经济组织》和《世界与中国》——提交市法律顾问，就针对出售这些卷册的书店提起法律诉讼一事征求其意见。

据市法律顾问告知，除《苏俄的经济组织》外，这些书籍均未列入中国国民党中央委员会查禁出版物清单，因此他无法建议依据《共产党法》对书商提起诉讼。

不过，理论上可以依据《出版法》提出指控，但在此特定情况下，他认为不宜坚持起诉，因为他确信很难获得定罪判决。

《苏俄的经济组织》被列入中国国民党中央委员会查禁书籍清单，但据市法律顾问称，若对商贩提出指控并判定有罪，仅会处以小额罚款。因此，他认为不宜坚持起诉。

现随函附上由上海特别区国民党党部发布的清单，列明在中国被禁止或查禁的书籍和期刊。此类出版物的商贩或印刷商可依据《出版法》被起诉。

（签名）
D. P. S.

特务科主管官员。

请仔细注意

following results :-

being available.
